[[Teizhan]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Tsumei Village}}

==Dialogue==
:''"My father fought in the [[Tengu Wars]]. He was a brave soldier, and he died with honor in battle. Now our people are supposed to be at peace with another. Ha! I shall never be at peace with those...birds! At least the [[Sensali]] Tengu are not off limits. I can kill as many of them as I want, and I plan on making them pay for what they did to my father. If you take up my cause and bring me 5 Feathered Scalps as proof that you have killed some Sensali Tengu, I shall give you this in return:"''
